reviews.title: The red tiles cossington
reviews.text:
Went to this newly reopened pub last Saturday evening with family and Staff very polite and helpful with gluten free options for one guest. 
That’s where the positives end as when meals arrived there were only three. Server went off and we assumed he was getting the last meal but he returned and left condiments, saying enjoy your meal. We asked where the fourth meal, as all ordered together was, and he looked surprised saying l will check and on return said there was a mishap on putting orders through and it would be out promptly.
By the time it eventually arrive all three other diners had nearly finished their meals.
The meals themselves were two steak pies off dish of the day menu, had meat that to say was undercooked was an understatement and the gluten free fish was also undercooked.
So all in a not very good experience had by all.

reviews.title: A trap in hotel booking
reviews.text:
I have used TA extensively to book vacations and events around the world. Booking a 1-night hotel in San Diego will end my extensive use on Trip Advisor. The hotel room was listed at $450 for a short event we wanted to attend. I took screenshots of the confirmation pages so I had all the details. The final page said “cancellation options available “. What it did not say is that the room had to be canceled 7 DAYS BEFORE ARRIVAL. Almost all hotels have a 24-48 hour cancellation.
When I called to cancel this hotel room on a Sunday before the next Saturday’s arrival, I was told by TA that the cancellation fee is $511!!!!!!! This is more than the room cost.

TA is using a 3rd party aggregator, who is the roadblock to canceling the room. The hotel said we are well within their 3-day cancellation policy and the hotel will not charge us. But TA says we will still be charged the $511 fee since their “hotel partner” requires it, not TA policy. So if you do not want to get caught in a grey area of blame and pointing fingers, BOOK YOUR TRAVEL NOT ON TRIP ADVISOR.

reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text: We booked a trip through TripAdvisor, and flew to Bangkok. This tour was a specialized one to learn the ins and outs of the jewelry trade district, as my family is gem cutters and we wanted to learn the Bangkok market. After confirming, we flew and booked 5 days in Bangkok, on the basis of this experience to learn the district. After we booked, a day or so later,we got a message that the company had sold out of that tour through their other platform and couldn’t honor ours. We tried to escalate this through TripAdvisor, as we booked our entire itinerary around this and spent thousands of dollars coming to Bangkok for this. TripAdvisor was useless, has no good contact options and didn’t respond to our urgent emails for 2 days. When they did, they said nothing about our problem and just suggested we book their other generic Bangkok tours. No solutions, no attempts to get the company for our experience to honor our booking. Completely useless, I would never recommend using TripAdvisor to book anything.

reviews.title: Don’t trust Tripadvisor I did for too long
reviews.text:
The key message is that Tripadvisor should give a Location a rating itself and give you all of the precautions and things to understand about the location itself

Not just specific hotels there. A good example of this as I was on the big island of Hawaii about a week ago and I’ve been there before 15 years ago. But in that time, this type of frog called a cookie frog had been invaded that area somehow and they were super loud. Night, only at night, so you get to your place to stay and check in everything’s fine but then when you go to sleep if the windows aren’t very high-quality and soundproofed and etc., then you start hearing that very loud frog chirping sound all night. If you’re in an older place you’re not gonna get much sleep.

So why doesn’t Tripadvisor tell you that about the place itself?

So that’s why I wouldn’t trust any reviews cause you really don’t know the picture of Location

I’ve been using Tripadvisor for 20+ years or whenever it started I started using Because I’ve been in the Travel industry my myself taking Students to Europe from the and I’ve been to many other countries so I’ve stayed in hotel hotels and done activities all over the world

reviews.title: What happened to the coconut cream pie?

We ordered the coconut cream pie tonight in Las Vegas the quality has fallen off a cliff. The custard layer was very thin and somewhat flavorless, and the whipped cream tasted over stabilized and almost fake. We have loved this pie for decades and are horrified at the abomination that we had in Vegas tonight.  We will be in Chicago next spring and hope that the pie is better there. What a disappointment.

reviews.title: not what it used to be
reviews.text:
Trip advisor used to offer great suggestions and did limited booking with high accuracy. Not any more.
I typed in dates for a search to confirm tour availability. Trip Advisor gave me a great tour, but on the wrong date. It booked a tour for the next day, instead of 6 weeks in the future. I did not catch the mistake. Lost $350 and got a wake-up call from Italy at 1:30 am with a tour guide upset that we were not at the meeting point. Double check everything you book and check all receipts for the dates.

reviews.title: Never again!
reviews.text:
Visited today for lunch with my family who are resident in Killarney. 
Menu limited. I had chicken & Caesar salad. Rather than Romaine lettuce it was made with an over abundance of Iceberg lettuce but the dressing was excellent. (? Shop brought from a bottle) 
My family both ate Sea food chowder which was excellent. 
Service however left a lot to be desired. Frequently throughout our lunch different waiting  staff intruded on our dining & conversation with “Everything ok guys?”  This became very intrusive & was unnecessary.
My wife ordered cheesecake & asked if she may share it with her sister therefore requesting an additional spoon & plate.It duly arrived with an extra spoon but with no addition plate so they shared the one plate!  This course was also frequently intruded upon by waiting staff asking if “Everything ok guys?”
I used the male toilets which are frankly disgusting . In one cubicle the  underside of the toilet seat was profusely stained with a brown stain which I believed to be faeces. This appeared to be throughly dried in. The other cubicle had water (?urine) on the floor. The toilet room itself had worn paintwork, & taps. It appeared uncared for, tired & dirty. I gave the Laurels 2 stars on the basis that my family who had the chowder enjoyed it.
I make no apology for saying that we won’t be eating at the Laurels again as won’t my family who live in Killarney.

reviews.title: Terrible Experience — Not Worth the Money
reviews.text:
We wanted to try the  all inclusive because of a friend’s referral. We had a swim out pool room. We had to move rooms three times. In room 5010, another guest was given our room and actually walked in on us talking. We were then moved because of ROACHES in rooms 5007 and 5001. There was also rust, cleanliness issues, a constantly blinking TV, and power problems. We even had to buy Lysol to clean and spray the room ourselves.

We paid a lot for what was supposed to be a relaxing, clean, and safe stay. Instead, the experience was extremely disappointing.

To be fair, Luiz, the hotel manager was great ! Also the front desk staff who welcomed us, the Elite Beach Host, and the waiters and waitresses were wonderful and provided great service.  Our cave excursion was top notch. Unfortunately, the room conditions overshadowed the good service we received.

We’ve stayed at Sandals before, and this experience was nothing like what we expected. Management needs to make this right.

They would not do that now when I go there, we come with a very large crowd there’s 16 to 20 people. So it takes a while to get served which we understand because we’re a large group. However, this is a blatant fault advertisement, and even though our group goes in for happy hour about half of the group orders from the regular menu. I’m of the opinion that they don’t need the business if that’s how they treat their customers.
